_metadata.description: AI generation of brand text and imagery via the AIProviderChain (Ollama-first, OpenRouter fallback), degrading gracefully when providers are absent.

requirements.title: Generate brand text via the Ollama-first provider chain
requirements.description: Palette, typography, and copy are generated through the AIProviderChain, trying Ollama first and falling back to OpenRouter, returning a structured draft brand.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/aigen/chain_test.go once the AIProviderChain is ported.

requirements.title: Generate brand imagery (logo, favicon, icon)
requirements.description: Image assets (logo, favicon, icon) are generated through the provider chain and stored as brand assets, referenced from the draft brand.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/aigen/image_test.go once image generation is ported.

requirements.title: Generation degrades gracefully when no provider is reachable
requirements.description: When neither OLLAMA_URL nor OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolves to a reachable provider, generation returns a clear degraded result/error rather than crashing, and other domains remain usable.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/aigen/degrade_test.go once graceful degradation is ported.
